description: COMILOG sources conflict on day-level onset (2 December versus night 3–4 December) and do not report participant counts or whether assemblies were public.
For transport-sector assembly, venue and attendance are unknown. The 747 SOGATRA employees are workforce size, not assembly participants.
For COMILOG the primary target appears to be company administration; sources mention labor-law arbitration and ministry mediation but no direct state-directed demand is established.
Official country code/baseline mapping is absent from assigned materials; ccode left null.
Three bounded queries and three opened sources do not establish exhaustive Q4 event coverage.
